question: 2026年6月这一段时间，华东的销售订单金额合计是多少
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS total_amount FROM sales_order o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.region = '华东' AND o.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01'

question: 现在可用量已经低于安全库存的物料清单
gold_sql: SELECT m.material_id, m.material_name, SUM(i.on_hand_qty - i.locked_qty) AS available_qty, m.safety_stock FROM material m JOIN inventory i ON i.material_id = m.material_id GROUP BY m.material_id, m.material_name, m.safety_stock HAVING SUM(i.on_hand_qty - i.locked_qty) < m.safety_stock ORDER BY (m.safety_stock - SUM(i.on_hand_qty - i.locked_qty)) DESC

question: 伺服电机的可用库存数量给我一下
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.on_hand_qty - i.locked_qty), 2) AS available_qty FROM inventory i JOIN material m ON m.material_id = i.material_id WHERE m.material_name = '伺服电机'

question: 还没到货的采购量，按供应商分别汇总并从大到小排
gold_sql: SELECT po.supplier_name, SUM(po.qty) AS in_transit_qty FROM purchase_order po WHERE po.status = 'in_transit' GROUP BY po.supplier_name ORDER BY in_transit_qty DESC, po.supplier_name

question: 计划完工日期在2026年6月的工单，逐条给出完工率
gold_sql: SELECT wo.wo_id, wo.planned_qty, wo.completed_qty, ROUND(wo.completed_qty * 1.0 / wo.planned_qty, 4) AS completion_rate FROM work_order wo WHERE wo.planned_end >= '2026-06-01' AND wo.planned_end < '2026-07-01' ORDER BY wo.wo_id

question: 销售订单按状态分组各有多少单
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM sales_order GROUP BY status ORDER BY order_count DESC

question: 库存金额按物料类别汇总，从高到低排
gold_sql: SELECT m.category, ROUND(SUM(i.on_hand_qty * m.standard_cost), 2) AS inventory_value FROM material m JOIN inventory i ON i.material_id = m.material_id GROUP BY m.category ORDER BY inventory_value DESC

question: 杭州智造科技有限公司每一张订单的金额明细
gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.due_date, o.status, ROUND(SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS amount FROM sales_order o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.customer_name = '杭州智造科技有限公司' GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_date, o.due_date, o.status ORDER BY o.order_date

question: ORD-1012 这张单的物料齐套率是多少
gold_sql: WITH RECURSIVE bt(root_id, parent_id, qty, level) AS (SELECT oi.material_id, oi.material_id, oi.qty, 0 FROM order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = 'ORD-1012' UNION ALL SELECT bt.root_id, b.child_material_id, bt.qty * b.qty_per_parent, bt.level + 1 FROM bt JOIN bom b ON b.parent_material_id = bt.parent_id), req AS (SELECT material_id, SUM(qty) AS required_qty FROM (SELECT oi.material_id, oi.qty FROM order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = 'ORD-1012' AND oi.material_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT parent_material_id FROM bom) UNION ALL SELECT bt.parent_id AS material_id, bt.qty FROM bt WHERE bt.level > 0) GROUP BY material_id), sup AS (SELECT m.material_id, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.on_hand_qty - i.locked_qty) FROM inventory i WHERE i.material_id = m.material_id), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(po.qty) FROM purchase_order po WHERE po.material_id = m.material_id AND po.status = 'in_transit'), 0) AS supply_qty FROM material m) SELECT r.material_id, m.material_name, r.required_qty, s.supply_qty, ROUND(MIN(1.0, s.supply_qty * 1.0 / r.required_qty), 4) AS fill_rate FROM req r JOIN material m ON m.material_id = r.material_id JOIN sup s ON s.material_id = r.material_id ORDER BY fill_rate ASC, r.material_id

question: 华南2026年6月的销售订单总金额，麻烦算一下
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS total_amount FROM sales_order o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.region = '华南' AND o.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01'

question: 全部销售按物料类别拆一下金额

question: 2026年6月已到货的采购数量按物料汇总

question: 先按订单汇总金额再求平均，单均金额是多少
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(t.amount), 2) AS avg_order_amount FROM (SELECT oi.order_id, SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS amount FROM order_item oi GROUP BY oi.order_id) AS t

question: FG001 的销售金额在全部销售金额里占多大比例
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN oi.material_id = 'FG001' THEN oi.qty * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 4) AS fg_share FROM order_item oi

question: 按销售代表汇总销售金额并做排名

question: 销售金额排第一的是哪个区域

question: 以2026年7月1日为基准往前数30天，这期间创建的订单有哪些

question: WH-A仓库里可用量跌破安全库存的物料有哪些

question: 在途采购的单数和数量，按供应商分组统计

question: 所有工单的完工量合计除以计划量合计是多少

question: FG001 的BOM逐层展开，每层分别是哪些物料和用量
gold_sql: WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree(parent_id, child_id, qty, level) AS (SELECT b.parent_material_id, b.child_material_id, b.qty_per_parent, 1 FROM bom b WHERE b.parent_material_id = 'FG001' UNION ALL SELECT bt.child_id, b.child_material_id, b.qty_per_parent, bt.level + 1 FROM bom_tree bt JOIN bom b ON b.parent_material_id = bt.child_id) SELECT bt.level, bt.child_id AS material_id, m.material_name, bt.qty FROM bom_tree bt JOIN material m ON m.material_id = bt.child_id ORDER BY bt.level, bt.child_id

question: 哪些物料在BOM里没有下级子件，属于末端件
gold_sql: SELECT m.material_id, m.material_name, m.category FROM material m WHERE m.material_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT b.parent_material_id FROM bom b) ORDER BY m.material_id

question: ORD-1001 的订单行明细，含每行金额
gold_sql: SELECT oi.material_id, m.material_name, oi.qty, oi.unit_price, oi.discount, ROUND(oi.qty * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount), 2) AS line_amount FROM order_item oi JOIN material m ON m.material_id = oi.material_id WHERE oi.order_id = 'ORD-1001' ORDER BY oi.material_id

question: 把可用库存和在途采购都算上之后，未发货订单还差哪些料、各差多少
gold_sql: SELECT m.material_id, m.material_name, COALESCE(d.demand_qty, 0) AS demand_qty, COALESCE(a.available_qty, 0) AS available_qty, COALESCE(t.in_transit_qty, 0) AS in_transit_qty, COALESCE(d.demand_qty, 0) - COALESCE(a.available_qty, 0) - COALESCE(t.in_transit_qty, 0) AS net_gap FROM material m LEFT JOIN (SELECT oi.material_id, SUM(oi.qty) AS demand_qty FROM sales_order o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'pending' GROUP BY oi.material_id) d ON d.material_id = m.material_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT i.material_id, SUM(i.on_hand_qty - i.locked_qty) AS available_qty FROM inventory i GROUP BY i.material_id) a ON a.material_id = m.material_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT po.material_id, SUM(po.qty) AS in_transit_qty FROM purchase_order po WHERE po.status = 'in_transit' GROUP BY po.material_id) t ON t.material_id = m.material_id WHERE COALESCE(d.demand_qty, 0) - COALESCE(a.available_qty, 0) - COALESCE(t.in_transit_qty, 0) > 0 ORDER BY net_gap DESC, m.material_id

question: 各客户待发货金额占其全部订单金额的比例是多少
gold_sql: WITH all_amount AS (SELECT o.customer_name, SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS total_amount FROM sales_order o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.customer_name), pending_amount AS (SELECT o.customer_name, SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS pending_value FROM sales_order o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'pending' GROUP BY o.customer_name) SELECT a.customer_name, ROUND(p.pending_value, 2) AS pending_value, ROUND(p.pending_value * 1.0 / a.total_amount, 4) AS pending_share FROM all_amount a JOIN pending_amount p ON p.customer_name = a.customer_name ORDER BY pending_share DESC, a.customer_name

question: 每种卖过的物料，历史销量是当前可用库存的多少倍
gold_sql: SELECT m.material_id, m.material_name, SUM(oi.qty) AS sold_qty, a.available_qty, ROUND(SUM(oi.qty) * 1.0 / a.available_qty, 4) AS sales_stock_ratio FROM order_item oi JOIN material m ON m.material_id = oi.material_id JOIN (SELECT i.material_id, SUM(i.on_hand_qty - i.locked_qty) AS available_qty FROM inventory i GROUP BY i.material_id) a ON a.material_id = m.material_id GROUP BY m.material_id, m.material_name, a.available_qty ORDER BY sales_stock_ratio DESC, m.material_id

question: 逐张订单比较下单数量和已发货数量的差额
gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_name, o.status, (SELECT SUM(oi.qty) FROM order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id) AS ordered_qty, (SELECT SUM(sh.shipped_qty) FROM shipment sh WHERE sh.order_id = o.order_id) AS shipped_qty, (SELECT SUM(oi.qty) FROM order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(sh.shipped_qty) FROM shipment sh WHERE sh.order_id = o.order_id), 0) AS open_qty FROM sales_order o ORDER BY open_qty DESC, o.order_id

question: 2026年6月相对5月的销售金额环比增幅是多少
gold_sql: WITH mo AS (SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS amount FROM sales_order o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-05-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY substr(o.order_date, 1, 7)) SELECT ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN month = '2026-06' THEN amount END) - MAX(CASE WHEN month = '2026-05' THEN amount END)) * 1.0 / MAX(CASE WHEN month = '2026-05' THEN amount END), 4) AS growth_rate FROM mo
